demand.explanation: D = a*CPU + b*GPU-active + c*NPU-active + d*memory-transfer + e*I/O + f*wakeups. Only CPU time is observed here; missing terms stay null. This partial D is not joules. Window demand assumes uniform CPU use within each actual sampling interval; 200 ms windows do not recover sub-interval peaks, and 50 ms peaks are not reported. Includes measured inter-phase gaps and idle tails; exited/short-lived processes can be undercounted. Working-set sums are not unique physical memory. Whole-device power, thermal state and non-Electron model children are not measured by this harness.

notes: Median and range are descriptive; few runs do not establish statistical significance.
CPU demand reduction does not prove power or energy reduction.
All phases contain completion snapshots and checkpoints for tracked application work, including after restore. This is not a GPU fence or a whole-system idle/energy measurement.
